==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|anie}} {{qualifier|obsolete}}
* {{l|en|anny}} {{qualifier|pronunciation spelling}}
* {{l|en|ony}}  {{qualifier|dialectal|Geordie}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:ani|:afeq|one|-y<id:adjectival>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|any}}, {{m|enm|eny}}, {{m|enm|ony}}, {{m|enm|ani}}, {{m|enm|aniȝ}}, {{m|enm|eniȝ}}, {{m|enm|æniȝ}}, from {{inh|en|ang|ǣniġ|t=any}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*ainīg}}, {{m|gmw-pro|*ainag}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*ainagaz}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*ainaz||one}}, equivalent to {{af|en|one|-y|id2=adjectival}}. 

Cognate with {{cog|stq|eenich|t=some}}, {{cog|fy|iennich|t=only}}, {{cog|nl|enig|t=any, some}}, {{cog|af|enig|t=any}}, {{cog|nds-de|enig|t=some}}, {{cog|de|einig|t=some}}; via {{cog|ine-pro|*óynos}} cognate with {{cog|la|ūllus||any}}, {{cog|la|ūnicus}} (whence {{cog|it|unico|t=unique}}, {{cog|fr|unique|t=unique}}). {{piecewise doublet|en|unique}}.

{{rfap|en|pin-pen merger & Ireland/Newfoundland}}

===Adverb===
{{wikidata lexeme|L333667}}
{{en-adv|-}}

# To even the slightest extent; [[at all]].
## {{n-g|Used before ''[[different]]'', before comparatives with {{m|en|more}} and {{m|en|less}}, and idiomatically before other comparatives, generally in [[interrogative]], [[hypothetical]], or negative contexts.}}
##: {{ux|en|If you get '''any''' taller, you'll start having to duck through doorways!}}
##: {{ux|en|Is she '''any''' less enthused now that it's raining?}}
##: {{ux|en|Is her enthusiasm '''any''' less now that it's raining?}}
##: {{ux|en|You don't seem to be '''any''' the worse after such a tragic experience.}}
##: {{ux|en|I will not remain here [[any longer|'''any''' longer]].}}
## {{lb|en|chiefly|_|US}} {{n-g|Used to modify a verb, generally a [[finite verb]] or a [[non-finite verb]] in [[object]] position.}}
##: {{ux|en|That doesn't bother me '''any'''.''}}
##: {{ux|en|Unfortunately, I don't expect the documentation to help '''any'''.}}

===Determiner===
{{wikidata lexeme|L3228}}
{{en-head|det}}

# {{lb|en|negative polarity item|or|interrogative|chiefly with plural or uncountable nouns}} One [[at all]]; at [[least]] one; at least one kind of; some; a positive quantity of.
#: {{ant|en|zero#Determiner|no#Determiner}}
#: {{hypo|en|q1=[[countable]]|one#Determiner|;|a few#Determiner|a [[couple#English:_small number|couple]] of|a [[handful#English:_small number|handful]] of|several#Determiner|;|multiple#Determiner|various#Determiner|;|a lot of#Determiner|many#Determiner|numerous#Determiner|;|countless#Determiner|;|q12=[[uncountable]]|a little#Determiner|much#Determiner}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|some#Determiner|all}}
#: {{ux|en|Do you have '''any''' biscuits?}}
#: {{usex|en|Do you have '''any''' food?}}
#: {{usex|en|Do you think there's '''any''' point to/in trying to explain?}}
#: {{usex|en|{{nowrap|It won't}} do you {{nowrap|'''any''' good}}.}}
#: {{usex|en|"Give me your pen." — "I don't have '''any''' pen."}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|Matthew|xi|27|text=No man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth '''any''' man the Father, save the Son.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=1|passage=In the old days, to my commonplace and unobserving mind, he gave no evidences of genius whatsoever. He never read me '''any''' of his manuscripts,{{nb...}}, and therefore my lack of detection of his promise may in some degree be pardoned.}}
#* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=19|passage=Meanwhile Nanny Broome was recovering from her initial panic and seemed anxious to make up for '''any''' kudos she might have lost, by exerting her personality to the utmost. She took the policeman's helmet and placed it on a chair, and unfolded his tunic to shake it and fold it up again for him.}}
# A/an, each or some, [[no matter]] its/their identity or nature.
#: {{ux|en|Choose '''any''' item you want.}}
#: {{usex|en|'''Any''' person may apply.}}
#: {{ux|en|[[representative democracy|Representative democracy]] is better than '''any''' other system.}} 
#: {{usex|en|Press '''any''' key to continue.}}
#: {{usex|en|The character '#' matches '''any''' digit 0–9.}} <!-- supposed to be an example of "each" -->
#: {{ux|en|Please bring some plates — '''any''' plates will do.}}
#: {{ux|en|I'll drink '''any''' whiskey you've got.}}
#* {{RQ:Hough Purchase Price|chapter=I|text=This new-comer was a man who in '''any''' company would have seemed striking. In complexion fair, and with blue or gray eyes, he was tall as any Viking, as broad in the shoulder.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-07-20|volume=408|issue=8845
|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/science-and-technology/21581981-what-pollution-some-opportunity-others-welcome-plastisphere Welcome to the plastisphere]
|passage=Plastics are energy-rich substances, which is why many of them burn so readily. '''Any''' organism that could unlock and use that energy would do well in the Anthropocene. Terrestrial bacteria and fungi which can manage this trick are already familiar to experts in the field.}}
# {{lb|en|with time designations}} An unspecified but [[imminent]] (second, minute, day etc.).
#: {{ux|en|They'll be arriving '''any''' day.}}
#: {{ux|en|I expect the phone to ring at '''any''' moment.}}
